metadata.title: Fixed model selection dropdown appearance and interaction
metadata.author: a-effort

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #3800

---

## 📝 Summary
 Replaces the native HTML `datalist` on the Model ID field in the Add/Edit LLM Model modal with a custom styled combobox. The datalist had two problems: it rendered as a browser-native tooltip bubble inconsistent with the rest of the admin UI, and after selecting a model it filtered suggestions down to a single matching entry, preventing the user from switching to a different model without manually clearing the field. The replacement uses a Tailwind-styled `ul` dropdown with vanilla JS event delegation, matching the existing patterns in the admin panel. Selecting a model populates the input; clicking the field again reopens the full list. Free-text entry for unlisted model IDs is preserved. Also fixes `overflow-hidden` on the model modal card which was clipping the dropdown and making items unclickable.

commits.message:
fix(ui): replace datalist with custom combobox for LLM model selection

Replace the browser-native <datalist> (inconsistent across browsers)
with a custom dropdown combobox for the LLM model-id picker. Adds
type-ahead filtering, click-to-select, and proper dark-mode styling.

Closes #3800

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Anna Effort

commits.message:
fix(ui): harden LLM model combobox against XSS and stale state

Use safe DOM APIs (createElement, textContent, dataset) instead of
innerHTML with string interpolation for model-id rendering.
Reset combobox state in editLLMModel to prevent stale dropdown
persisting from a previous modal session.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(ui): add ARIA, keyboard nav, race guard, and empty-state fix to combobox

Address Codex review findings:
- Add ARIA combobox semantics (role=combobox/listbox/option,
  aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant).
- Add keyboard navigation: ArrowDown/ArrowUp to highlight,
  Enter to select, Escape to close (stops propagation so the
  modal stays open).
- Guard fetchModelsForModelModal against out-of-order responses
  by re-checking the current provider value after await.
- Suppress empty-state dropdown ("No models found") before any
  fetch has occurred (_llmModelsFetched flag).
- Guard scrollIntoView for JSDOM compatibility.
- Update tests: 34 tests covering all new behavior.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(ui): close same-provider race in model fetch with sequence counter

Replace provider-value-only stale guard with a monotonic _llmFetchSeq
counter. Each fetchModelsForModelModal call bumps the counter and
captures the current value; responses whose seq no longer matches
(because a newer fetch was started — same or different provider) are
silently discarded. The provider-value check is kept as belt-and-
suspenders for provider changes without a new fetch.

Add test for concurrent same-provider requests resolving out of order.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
